invariants.rationale: The method assigns the return value to 'this.partitioner' using a cast and returns it, which strongly suggests it is not null.
Because the result is cast to JavaUpsertPartitioner before being returned, it must be an instance of this type.
The parameter 'profile' is directly used as an argument in the super method call, so the method likely expects it to be non-null.
The method stores the value from super.getUpsertPartitioner(profile) into 'this.partitioner' and returns it, so they are always equal at method exit.
